I had my dental implant done with Dr. Waruth, and I’m really happy with the experience. At first, he mentioned I might need a bone graft, but on the day of the procedure he reassessed and said it wasn’t necessary. I really appreciated his honesty and that he only recommended what was truly needed.

The procedure went very smoothly. I barely felt any pain afterward, just a bit of swelling on the first day even though I was told recovery could take 3–5 days. The stitches were very neat and everything healed well with no inflammation.

The clinic feels modern, clean, and well equipped. Overall, the quality of care and materials is very good, and the price is reasonable for the level of treatment.

Highly recommend

For anyone looking for a dentist in Chiang Mai who can handle everything in one go, I highly recommend this place. I've had continuous treatment here, from orthodontics to dental implants. The specialist dentists plan everything very well; you don't have to drive around to multiple places, saving you the hassle.

There's plenty of parking (my biggest plus!). The clinic is clean and well-maintained. Most importantly, the dentists are incredibly kind and gentle. I was also impressed with the staff; they were always helpful in coordinating appointments. I admit I was so busy I almost forgot several times, but they reminded me via LINE, which helped me get my ongoing treatments done smoothly. Now my teeth are perfectly aligned and functioning well. If you're looking for a good dental clinic in Chiang Mai, give this place a try. Personally, I think it's a great option.

I can honestly say all the dentists are very gentle and kind. They chatted with me throughout the treatment. If you're looking for a good, high-quality clinic in the Mae Hia area, I highly recommend it. I especially love that they offer free water, and sometimes even give out free toothpaste! 🥹💯❤️

I have to admit, I'm terrified of wisdom tooth extraction. I postponed my appointment several times, but this one was hurting so much I decided to try this place. The dentist was incredibly kind and chatted with me, which made me forget my fear. During the procedure, they were so gentle; I didn't feel like anything was being pried open. It was over in no time. I wasn't very sore afterward. The staff were also very nice, constantly checking on me to make sure I was okay. It's easy to get here, and there's convenient parking. If you're like me and afraid of dentists, I highly recommend this place. The dentist is truly skilled.
